summary: Phase-4 full test pass. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase4.py (27 tests) covering memories CRUD+upsert+isolation, learn articles/daily, what-if simulator, expanded profile persistence, chat memory retrieval + FY 2025-26 tax context, plus regression on demo/auth/goals/passkey/statements — 27/27 pass. Existing Phase-2/3 suites re-run: 63 passed / 6 skipped. Frontend (Playwright, public URL, real login): branding, Profile CRUD+persistence, Goals create/edit/delete, Daily Learn card, What-If (line chart, demo disabled), Analysis LineChart, Settings (account name, passkey, AI memory add/delete/clear, theme light/dark/system), Voice mic + read-aloud UI, memory-aware chat answer (₹90,000), demo mode banner/ask/profile-redirect, sign-out — all pass EXCEPT Learn article detail, which is broken (404 'Article not found') for every article in both auth and demo mode.

minor.issue: Upsert overwrites created_at with now() and assigns a brand-new uuid id on every re-post, so the previously returned id becomes stale and original creation time is lost ($setOnInsert _created_first is written but never returned).

Once a user's profile is populated, history is returned as all-zero months while summary uses profile values, so the dashboard cash-flow chart is flat/empty and the 'Worth noticing' insight prints a nonsensical line ('After dipping in June, you saved ₹90,000 this month').

session_id is a fixed string per user+provider ('finaura-{uid}-{provider}') with no reset path, so LLM conversation context grows unbounded across sessions and stale answers can persist even after memories/profile change.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: every Learn article opens with 'Article not found.'. RCA: AppWorkspace does manual pathname routing under a catch-all route, so useParams().id in ArticleDetail is undefined and the app requests GET /api/learn/articles/undefined (404, verified in network log). Backend detail endpoint works fine. Fix: derive the id in AppWorkspace (raw.split('/learn/')[1]) and pass it as a prop, or register a real <Route path='/learn/:id'>. This also blocks article-title/article-body, article-back-button and the article 'Ask FINAURA AI' prompt-seed flow.
Still renders lowercase brand 'finaura' instead of 'FINAURA AI' — visible on every cold load / route transition.

Dashboard 'Worth noticing' insight card heading disappears in dark mode

critical_code_review_comments: App.js AppWorkspace hand-rolls path parsing for /learn/:id while react-router is available — this is exactly why useParams() is empty in ArticleDetail; move article routing into the Routes tree.
App.js is 1074 lines and contains Dashboard, Goals, Learn, Ask, Settings and 4 settings sub-sections; split into src/pages/* modules for maintainability.
memories.py add_memory: $set spreads the whole doc (including a fresh uuid and created_at) on upsert — set id/created_at only via $setOnInsert.
server.py chat(): fixed session_id per user gives no way to reset conversation context; consider a client-supplied session id or reset endpoint.
